question: Phenylketonuria occurs as a consequence of the deficiency of phenylalanine hydroxylase and severely affects the central nervous system. Its mode of hereditary transmission is the following:

options.opb: Transmission linked to the X chromosome
options.opd: It is transmitted by the mother, because the gene is in the mitochondrial chromosome.

analysis: Phenylketonuria is inherited in an autosomal recessive pattern, meaning that both copies of the gene in each cell have mutations. This condition is not linked to the X chromosome, not autosomal dominant, and not transmitted by the mother through mitochondrial DNA.
